spec-framework@0.60.66:
WRITE THE SPEC IN THE SPEC COMPILER'S FORMAT — one fenced block, its path on the fence line:
```yaml spec/<name>.spec
spec:
  meta:
    name: <name>
    version: 0.1.0
    uuid: <name>-v1
    purpose: >
      What it is for, in one or two sentences.
  axioms:
    AX-001: "A rule it must never break."
  modules:
    - id: <module-id>
      description: "What this module does."
      path: <folder/file.js>
      exports:
        - "doThing(input: string) → Result"
      behavioral_contracts:
        - "Given X, doThing returns Y."
      error_paths:
        - "Bad input → throws with a reason."
  schemas:
    - id: Result
      fields:
        ok: boolean
        value: string
  tests:
    - "doThing on an empty string is refused."
```
Required: spec.meta (name, version, purpose, uuid) and spec.modules (each with id and description). Each export is "name(params) → returns". Write only what the request and the code support; leave a key out rather than invent it.
